agent_hint: The agent is not installed yet. Run a one-time command on the server as root.
agent_hint_ssh: The agent is not installed yet. Run a one-time command on the server as root. Or let the controller run it once over its own SSH access.
apply_started: The node is applying the settings.
awg_hint: Paste a full AWG parameter set (name = value lines) or type auto.
bootstrap_confirm: Install the VPN protocols on this server?
command_expired: The install command expired. Get a new one.
command_run: Copy the command and run it on the server as root. Once the agent answers, the protocols install automatically.
enrollment_agent_enrollment_rejected: The agent on the server rejected the command: it was installed with another one. Run the latest command again.
enrollment_agent_owned_by_another_node: The agent on the server belongs to another active node.
error_awg_duplicate: An AWG parameter is empty or repeated.
error_awg_empty: Paste a full AWG parameter set or type auto.
error_awg_line: Write AWG parameters as name = value.
error_host: {field}: a DNS name or an IPv4 address.
error_interface: The AWG interface starts with a letter: up to 15 letters, digits, _ or -.
error_path: The XHTTP path starts with / and holds URL path characters.
error_sni: SNI must be a DNS name with at least two labels.
error_transport: Choose at least one VLESS transport.
limits_hint: Values for this server replace the installation's.
local_confirm: Install the agent on the controller's server?
local_hint: This is the controller's own server: the agent installs without a command.
port_access_hint: Only the controller talks to the agent: mutual TLS guards its port. Limit the port to the controller address only if that address is static — a changed address leaves the agent unreachable.
port_open: the agent port is open, mutual TLS guards it
port_restricted: the agent port accepts only the controller address
protocols_hint: The settings are complete: the VPN protocols can be installed.
protocols_tab_hint: Mark the server's protocols; new ones install when applied.
region_confirm: The new region changes access for {count} profiles.
settings_incomplete: Fill in the protocol settings first.
ssh_running: The controller runs the install command over SSH; it signs in once and keeps no access.
waiting_agent: Waiting for the command to run on the server; the card updates by itself.
new_lead: The server first appears in the list as an invitation. Its page then installs the agent and the VPN protocols.
new_template_hint: The code, name, region and flag come from the location; the code is {key} or the next free number.
new_key_invalid: Code: Latin letters, digits, “-” and “_”, up to 64 characters, starting with a letter or digit.
new_title_invalid: Enter a name of up to 128 characters.
new_region_invalid: Enter a region of up to 128 characters.
new_flag_invalid: A flag is up to 16 characters.
new_host_invalid: Enter a public domain or IPv4, without a user, scheme or port.
new_node_key_retired: This code belonged to a removed server and is no longer used.
new_target_hint: The controller can install the agent through it itself; the SSH port is 22.
new_host_hint: The domain or IP clients use to reach the VPN.
new_host_local_hint: The controller host's domain or IP; “.” takes the controller's address.
new_agent_only: Without protocols only the agent goes on the server.
diagnostics_node_agent_unconfigured: Diagnostics unavailable: the agent connection is not configured. Recovery is below.
diagnostics_node_agent_unavailable: Diagnostics unavailable: the agent does not answer. Recovery is below.
diagnostics_driver_unavailable: Diagnostics unavailable: the node driver does not answer. Recovery is below.
recovery_more: And {count} more. They are listed under System.
recovery_hint_maintenance: Wait for controller maintenance to finish.
recovery_hint_child: Recover the related installation step, then check this operation again.
recovery_hint_agent: Check the agent connection and installation logs.
recovery_hint_bootstrap: Check the agent connection, then recheck this setup.
recovery_hint_journal: Recheck the recorded result before resolving the block.
recovery_hint_removal: Check which server resources remain after removal.
recovery_hint_worker: Wait for the worker or inspect its logs.
recovery_explain_recheck: Read the result of this exact saved operation. Nothing is launched; missing evidence keeps the block.
recovery_explain_resolve: Recover this operation using confirmed server evidence.
recovery_explain_resume: Continue the saved checkpoint. Unknown remote commands retain their identity and are not replayed.
recovery_explain_cancel: Cancel only work whose execution boundary is confirmed safe. Unknown outcomes keep their fences.
recovery_explain_force: The node agent restarts to stop previous execution. The operation is cancelled with an unknown outcome; VPN containers and configurations are not deliberately removed.
recovery_explain_profile_force: The node agent restarts to stop previous execution. The access operation is cancelled with an unknown outcome — its change may already have taken effect. Apply node settings or reconcile access afterwards.
recovery_explain_bootstrap_cancel: Stop setup only after confirming or fencing the current step. Installed components remain; remove the node separately if needed.
recovery_explain_bootstrap_resolve: Recover the saved step. An interrupted command is fenced before a replacement can run.
recovery_explain_agent_resume: Continue setup after confirming a safe installation boundary or a removed previous owner. The saved operation identity is retained.
recovery_explain_agent_recheck: Check the agent identity and build, or verify a retired previous owner over SSH. This does not change the agent or its journals.
recovery_explain_temporary_resolve: Cancel only after the agent confirms the lease and peer are absent and fences the original command.
recovery_explain_profile_resolve: Retire the uncertain journal entry after agent restart, then reconcile current profile access.
recovery_explain_settings_resolve: Retire the uncertain settings entry after agent restart, then apply current settings as a new revision.
recovery_explain_issuance_cancel: Close the failed configuration request. Existing VPN access and configurations remain available.
cause_runtime_owner_conflict: Another node's VPN already runs on this server. Nothing was changed; remove that VPN before setting up this node.
cause_node_agent_unconfigured: The agent connection is not configured.
actions_unavailable: Actions are available once the agent answers and the VPN is installed.
actions_busy: An operation is running on the server; wait for it to finish.
effect_reinstall_keep: Reinstall VPN protocols and keep existing configurations.
effect_reinstall_clean: Delete existing VPN configurations and reinstall protocols. Users will need new configurations.
effect_check_ports: Check whether the selected ports are available.
effect_open_ports: Allow VPN ports through the server firewall.
effect_sync_runtime: Update the server runtime scripts and VPN container images; a container with a changed image restarts.
effect_reconcile_access: Apply profile access permissions on this server.
effect_regenerate_entropy: Generate new AmneziaWG parameters. Users will need new configurations.
effect_cleanup_runtime: Delete VPN containers and configurations. Connections will stop working.
done_reinstall_keep: Reinstall completed. Server configs preserved; access is synchronizing.
done_reinstall_clean: Clean reinstall completed. Access is synchronizing; users need new configs.
done_regenerate_entropy: AWG entropy regenerated. Users must obtain new configs.
done_cleanup_runtime: Protocol containers and configs removed. Server and agent retained.
job_blocked: Result unconfirmed. The operation waits for recovery under Diagnostics.
firewall_unmanaged: UFW is not installed. Check external firewall rules separately.
removal_invitation: No agent is installed on the server: removal only takes away its record.
drain_grants: Access to the server is revoked from {count} profiles.
drain_runtime: VPN containers and configuration files are removed.
drain_agent: The agent checks the server, then removes itself.
drain_registry: The server record goes once the agent stops answering.
registry_grants: The server leaves {count} profiles and future access rules, and its record is removed.
registry_runtime: Files, containers and the agent remain on the server.
registry_tunnels: Existing VPN configurations may continue working.
registry_use: Removing only the record is for a server that cannot be checked and cleaned.
removed_agent: Server removed. Its agent found no runtime left; the agent's own removal is not verified.
removal_error_node_agent_unavailable: The agent is unreachable. Check the connection before retrying.
removal_error_node_agent_unconfigured: The agent is unreachable. Check the connection before retrying.
removal_error_host_verification_failed: Cleanup could not be verified. Some server resources may remain.
removal_error_node_cleanup_scope_unconfi: VPN runtime is present or could not be checked, but this server has no confirmed VPN installation. Full cleanup stopped.
removal_error_agent_still_running: The agent checked the server but still answers instead of removing itself. Check the node-plane-agent service.
removal_error_agent_host_check_missing: It is unknown whether the agent checked the server and removed itself. Check the server, then remove only the record.
removal_error_agent_update_required: The agent is too old for removal without SSH. Update it, then retry.
removal_error_node_settings_uncertain: Recover the unfinished installation operation first.
removal_error_node_operation_pending: Recover the unfinished installation operation first.
removal_error_agent_rollout_uncertain: Recover the unfinished installation operation first.
removal_error_node_bootstrap_pending: Recover the unfinished installation operation first.
port_state_listening: a listener exists (possibly this node’s container)
